[[2023 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] champions |tourney=[[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Second Round }} {{2022–23 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2022–23 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team''' represented [[Marquette University]] during the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team is led by second-year head coach [[Shaka Smart]] and plays their home games at [[Fiserv Forum]] in [[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, Wisconsin]] as a member of the [[Big East Conference]]. The Eagles finished the season 29–7, 17–3 in Big East play to win the regular season championship. They defeated [[2022–23 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]], [[2022–23 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]], and [[2022–23 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] to win the [[2023 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the East region. They defeated [[2022–23 Vermont Catamounts men's basketball team|Vermont]] in the First Round before losing to [[2022–23 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the Second Round of the tournament. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Golden Eagles]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 19–13, 11–8 in Big East play to finish a tie for fifth place.{{Cite web |title=2021-22 Marquette Golden Eagles Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/marquette/2022-schedule.html |access-date=2022-11-11 |website=College Basketball at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}} As the No. 5 seed, they lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2021–22 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]].{{Cite web |title=Marquette vs. Creighton - Game Recap - March 10, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401403345 |access-date=2022-11-11 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 9 seed in the East Region, where they lost in the First Round to [[2021–22 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]].{{Cite web |title=Marquette vs. North Carolina - Game Summary - March 17, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401408583 |access-date=2022-11-11 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
